events.text: Rogers Morton briefly joins the post as domestic policy advisor

evidence.quote: with former United States Secretary of Commerce Rogers Morton briefly joining them as a domestic policy advisor in early 1976

events.text: Clayton Yeutter fills the position after resigning as RNC chairman

evidence.quote: In 1992 , it was filled by Clayton Yeutter following his resignation

events.text: Position stops being a Cabinet-level post

evidence.quote: It remained a Cabinet-level position until 1993

events.text: Obama appoints Pete Rouse as counselor to the president

evidence.quote: On January 6 , 2011 , President Obama appointed Rouse as counselor to the president

events.text: Steve Bannon departs the White House, leaving the position

evidence.quote: After Bannons departure from the White House in August 2017

events.text: Johnny DeStefano given the title, overseeing presidential personnel offices

evidence.quote: Johnny DeStefano was given the title in February 2018

events.text: Hope Hicks announced to return to the White House in the role

evidence.quote: In February 2020 , it was announced that former White House Communications Director Hope Hicks would return

undated_mentions: Position created during the Richard Nixon administration with Cabinet rank
Robert T. Hartmann and John O. Marsh shared the post during the Gerald Ford presidency
Position vacant during the Jimmy Carter administration
Edwin Meese held the position during the first term of Ronald Reagan
Meese left the position when he became US attorney general in Reagan's second term; post left vacant
Position vacant in the first three years of George H.W. Bush's term
Position initially abolished under the Obama administration; duties transferred to Axelrod, Rouse and Jarrett
John Podesta was the last holder before leaving to chair the Hillary Clinton 2016 campaign (departure date not stated)
